spans.s: क्षेत्र n. 1. Landed property, soil, a field, e.g. चीयते बालिशस्यापि सत्क्षेत्रपतिता कृषिः Mud.i., M.x.114; 2. place, region, कपटशतमयं क्षेत्रमप्रत्ययानाम् Bhartr.i.77, Sant.S.ii.3, Megh.i.16; 3. a sacred spot, a place of pilgrimage, क्षेत्रं क्षुत्रप्रधनंपिशुनं कौरवं तद्भजेथाः Megh.i.46, Bg.i.1; 4. an enclosed spot of ground; 5. fertile soil; 6. place of origin; 7. the body considered as the abode of the soul, योगिनो यं विचिन्वंति क्षेत्राभ्यंतरवर्तिनम् K.S.vi.77, Bg.xiii.1, 2; 8. the mind; 9. a wife, तौ तु जातौ परक्षेत्रे M.iii.175; 10. a house, a town; 11. a plain figure (in Geometry), a diagram.
क्षेत्र-अधिदेवता f. the tutelary deity of any consecrated piece of ground.
क्षेत्र-आजीव, -कर m. a cultivator, a husbandman.
क्षेत्र-आजीव, -कर m. a cultivator, a husbandman.
क्षेत्र-गणित n. Geometry.
क्षेत्र-गत a. geometrical.
क्षेत्र-उपपत्ति f. geometrical proof.
क्षेत्र-ज (I) a. 1. produced in a field; 2. born from the body.
क्षेत्र-ज (II) m. the offspring of the wife by a kinsman duly appointed to raise up issue to the husband, M.ix.167, Yaj.i.69.
क्षेत्र-जात a. begotten on the wife of another.
क्षेत्र-ज्ञ (I) a. 1. knowing localities; 2. clever, dexterous.
क्षेत्र-ज्ञ (II) m. 1. the soul; 2. the supreme soul, Bg.xii.2; 3. a libertine; 4. a husbandman.
क्षेत्र-पति m. a land-owner, a landlord.
क्षेत्र-पद n. a place sacred to a deity.
क्षेत्र-पाल m. 1. a man employed to guard a field; 2. a deity protecting fields; 3. an epithet of Śiva.
क्षेत्र-फल n. the superficial contents of a figure (in math.).
क्षेत्र-भक्ति f. the division of a field.
क्षेत्र-भूमि f. cultivated land.
क्षेत्र-राशि m. the quantity represented by geometrical figures.
क्षेत्र-विद् (I) a. See क्षेत्रज्ञ.
क्षेत्र-विद् (II) m. 1. a husbandman; 2. a sage who possesses spiritual knowledge, K.S.iii.50; 3. the soul.
क्षेत्र-स्थ a. residing at a sacred place.
क्षेत्रिक (I) a. (f. की) Relating to a field.
क्षेत्रिक (II) m. 1. A farmer, M.viii.241, 243; 2. a husband.
क्षेत्रिक (I) a. (f. की) Relating to a field.
क्षेत्रिन् m. 1. An agriculturist, Yaj.ii.161; 2. a husband; 3. the soul; 4. the supreme soul, Bg.xiii.33.
क्षेत्रिय (I) a. (f. या) 1. Relating to a field; 2. curable in a future body, i.e. incurable in the present life, e.g. आवेदयति नितांतं क्षेत्रियरोगं सखि हृदंतः K.Pr.x.
क्षेत्रिय (II) n. 1. An organic disease; 2. meadow, grass, pasturage.
क्षेत्रिय (III) m. An adulterer.
क्षेत्रिय (I) a. (f. या) 1. Relating to a field; 2. curable in a future body, i.e. incurable in the present life, e.g. आवेदयति नितांतं क्षेत्रियरोगं सखि हृदंतः K.Pr.x.

क्षेप m. 1. Throwing, tossing, moving, भ्रूक्षेपमात्रानुमितप्रवेशाम् K.S.iii.60, Megh.i.47; 2. sending, striking down; 3. transgressing; 4. passing away (time), delay, dilatoriness; 5. insult, abuse, क्षेपं करोति चेद्दण्ड्यः Yaj.ii.204; 6. disrespect, contempt; 7. pride, haughtiness; 8. nosegay.
क्षेपक (I) a. (f. का) 1. A thrower, a sender; 2. interpolated; 3. abusive, disrespectful.
क्षेपक (II) m. A spurious or interpolated passage.
क्षेपक (I) a. (f. का) 1. A thrower, a sender; 2. interpolated; 3. abusive, disrespectful.
क्षेपण n. 1. Throwing, sending; 2. spending (as time); 3. omitting; 4. abusing.
क्षेपणि f. 1. An oar; 2. a net for fishing; 3. a sling or any instrument with which missiles are thrown.
क्षेम (I) a. (f. मा) 1. Conferring happiness, ease or benefit, धार्तराष्ट्रा रणे हन्युस्तन्मे क्षेमतरं भवेत् Bg.i.45; 2. prosperous, secure, happy.

क्षेम (II) m.n. 1. Safety, peace, happiness, well-being, दधतु वः क्षेमं कटाक्षोर्मयः Git.G.iii., वितन्वति क्षेममदेवमातृकाश्चिराय तस्मिन् कुरवश्च्कासते Kir.i.17, M.ii.127; 2. preserving, protecting, R.xv.6; 3. keeping what is acquired, Cf. योग; 4. final beatitude, eternal happiness; 5. a kind of perfume.
क्षेम (I) a. (f. मा) 1. Conferring happiness, ease or benefit, धार्तराष्ट्रा रणे हन्युस्तन्मे क्षेमतरं भवेत् Bg.i.45; 2. prosperous, secure, happy.
क्षेमकर a. propitious, causing peace and security.
क्षेमकर a. propitious, causing peace and security.
क्षेमिन् a. (f. णी) Safe, secure, happy.
क्षेमिन् a. (f. णी) Safe, secure, happy.
